source: PHC Core Rules v1.0, rules revision 1.8 (Outburst 4.0, accepted direction 9 Nov 2026; docs/design/outburst-4.0-spec.md), on rules 1.5 (Outburst 2.0, accepted 8 Nov 2026; docs/design/outburst-2.0-proposal.md). Module names from the 2020 Recovered Design Notes.

cycle.text: Begin (2 AP, Swift 1) opens a ready design at stage 0 (+1 Strain). Pump (1 AP) +1 stage, to 4, plain or with a feeling (rules 1.8). Release (1 AP) fires it: x0.8 / 1 / 1.4 / 1.8 / 2.2. Held past your turn: +1 stage free at your next turn start (the swell), +1 Strain (+2 Flooded). The first Pump each fight is free; Empathy 3: 1 free Pump a round; Empathy 7: 2. Revert Pump (0 AP) undoes the last pump this turn.

calming.text: Every turn start: −1 Strain, always (before the swell).
A turn of stillness: end a turn in which you didn't Begin, Pump or Feed: −1 more.
Fighting it out: your first weapon attack each turn (melee or shot): −1.
Tending others: your first heal, stim, shield or cleanse given to an ally each turn: −1.
Let it go (free, on your turn): drop the held Outburst; Strain falls by its stage, at most the Strain its swells cost (item 541); the meter +1.
Steady the heart (1 AP, only while holding): −1 Strain, and the held Outburst doesn't swell at your next turn start.

aura.text: Holding an elemental Outburst: enemies adjacent to you at the start of your turn take 5 Elemental and the tone's stage-1 rider.

resonance.text: A release by an ally after another ally's release in the same round: +0.2 on the stage multiplier for each earlier ally releaser this round, at most +0.4 in total per release. The players' side only: enemies never resonate.

heart_overwatch.text: While holding (and watching), release as your reaction when an enemy enters your design's reach.

feed.text: Absorb a glyph on your own tile into your held Outburst: +1 stage; the glyph is gone.

second_school.text: A second school with its own option, at half strength, after the first.

default_form.name: Bolt
default_form.text: One target at the aim, within reach (4 tiles + the Soul range bonus); rolls Will Power against Defense.

stage_shift.text: Element riders count one stage higher in Flooded air, one lower in Thin air (0 to 4).

cost_rules: (school base + modules + 10 for a second school + the tone's cost) × the band's Soul cost × (1 − 5% × (Insight − 1)), minimum 5; +20% under a Right Brain Debuff. Paid at Begin.

limits.tones: one at Lore Master 1 (rules 1.8; was Visualization 1); more from tutors or plates

notes: Every number from rules 1.5 is provisional until the damage balance pass. Forms are modules (family 'form', one per design, they take a slot); tones take no slot. Retired modules are listed in 'retired' with what an old design gets instead.

schools.name: Damage
schools.text: 20 damage × the Soul multiplier × the stage multiplier (Raw: Soul damage, armour ignored; an element: Elemental, armour half). Bolt and Lance roll Will Power against Defense; the areas don't roll.

schools.name: Buff
schools.text: Allies: heal 30 × Healing multiplier × the stage multiplier, or Inspired (+2 to hit) or Guarded (+2 Defense) for 2 rounds.

schools.name: Control
schools.text: Push or pull 3 tiles, or Pinned, or Slowed, 2 rounds (Body save).

schools.name: Status
schools.text: Fear, Shaken, Confused, or a Left or Right Brain Debuff, 2 rounds (Heart or Brain save).

tones.name: Raw
tones.text: Soul damage: ignores armour. No rider.

4.text: Burning 2 rounds; it spreads to foes next to each target; the ground under the target burns.

2.text: Ignores half cover; chains to 1 more enemy within 2 tiles at half.

3.text: Ignores half cover; chains to 1 more enemy within 2 tiles at half.

4.text: Ignores half cover; chains to 2 more within 2 tiles at half; Shaken (Heart save).
Slowed and Pinned 1 round, no save.

tones.name: Stone
tones.text: Elemental (stone): armour counts half at stage 0; from stage 1 it counts in full and the hit deals +10.

4.text: Armour in full, +10; Prone (Body save); rubble rises on the empty tiles around the target.
Pushes the target 3 tiles and everyone else within 1 of it 2 tiles.
Corroded, no save, and Defense −2 more while it lasts.

retired.why: Replaced by the Burst shape (radius 1; Rain + Size becomes Burst + Size).
Its sight-free half became Ether; moving an ally is the Narrator's (no engine effect).
Retired: the shapes (Burst, Wave, Lance) and Storm's chains cover more than one target.
Retired: Fire's Burning, Acid's Corroded and the held aura carry damage over time.
Retired: Heart Overwatch does it (release as a reaction when an enemy enters reach).
Retired: holding is the delayed blast now.
Retired: the engine never counted casts; stages do the growing.

items.text: Cost −10, but the engine picks the aim among every creature within reach (a Bolt or Burst lands on one of them; a Wave or Lance faces one).

items.name: Wave
items.text: Shape: a 3-tile cone from you toward the aim (Size: 4). Everyone in it, no roll; damage ×0.7.
items.look: a violet crescent rolling off your chest

items.name: Burst
items.text: Shape: radius 1 around the aimed tile (Size: radius 2). Everyone in it, no roll; damage ×0.7. Old Rain designs become Burst.
items.look: a heart-shaped bloom opening at the aim

items.name: Aura
items.text: Shape: radius 1 around you, all at once (Size: radius 2); no aim. You are spared unless it's a Buff. Damage ×0.6.
items.look: a ring of violet heat breaking off you

items.name: Lance
items.text: Shape: a straight 4-tile line from you toward the aim (8 directions), piercing everyone on it (Size: 6); walls stop it. Each target rolls; damage ×0.8.
items.look: a narrow violet spear of light

items.name: Split
items.text: Two targets: a Bolt also strikes the nearest other creature within 2 of the aim that the school reaches, at full power. Bolt only.

items.name: Ricochet
items.text: A Bolt bounces off walls and cover: with a wall or cover tile within 2 of the aim it needs no line of sight and ignores half cover.

items.name: Fuse
items.text: The release lands and waits: it goes off at the start of your next turn, or when a creature steps into its area, whichever comes first.

items.name: Return
items.text: Out and back: a Bolt or Lance strikes each target twice (each strike rolls).

items.name: Volley
items.text: A Bolt becomes 3 small bolts at the aim, each x0.4, each rolling.

items.name: Bloom
items.text: A Burst or Aura grows +1 radius a stage reached.

items.name: Anchor
items.text: Targets hit are Pinned 1 round (Body save).

items.name: Lure
items.text: Targets hit are pulled 2 tiles toward you.

items.name: Shell
items.text: As it leaves, you gain a shield of the release's power x 0.5.

items.name: Linger
items.text: The area stays as a field for 2 rounds: a creature of the side it works on that starts its turn there takes 5 (Damage, plus the tone's stage-1 rider) or heals 5 (Buff).

items.name: Quiet
items.text: The hold's Strain (Begin, swells, feelings) is halved, rounded down; the release x0.8.

items.name: Silent
items.text: Begin, Pump and Release don't reveal you while Hidden.

items.name: Thread
items.text: A Buff release threads the first two allies it reaches: the next heal on one heals the other as much (once).

items.name: Echo
items.text: Casts again next turn at half. Learned only with the class, when its batch goes live.

items.name: Cascade
items.text: +1 target a stage. Learned only with the class, when its batch goes live.

items.name: Tether
items.text: A beam between you and an ally that hits what crosses it. Learned only with the class, when its batch goes live.

items.name: Siphon
items.text: Steals MP. Learned only with the class, when its batch goes live.

items.name: Phantom
items.text: Passes through cover. Learned only with the class, when its batch goes live.

items.name: Orbit
items.text: Circles you for 2 rounds, hitting what comes near. Learned only with the class, when its batch goes live.

items.name: Volatile
items.text: A kill makes the target explode. Learned only with the class, when its batch goes live.

items.name: Bastion
items.text: Shell on every ally in the shape. Learned only with the class, when its batch goes live.

items.name: Judgement-mark
items.text: The target takes +25% from all sources for a round. Learned only with the class, when its batch goes live.

items.name: Halo
items.text: The Release also blesses with a Whisper effect. Learned only with the class, when its batch goes live.

practice.text: Each Release earns 1, +1 per stage reached past 1, +1 per feeling poured in (a wild release none). A module pick at 5 practice, the second at 15, then every +15. Each Mastery level (3/5/7/9) in a gate skill adds +5 practice; Mastered (10) in one gives a free pick from the modules it gates.

gates.text: A module needs 2 points in its gate skill (4 for the second tier) to be learned by practice, a Mastered pick, a plate or a tutor. The Narrator's grants and the Proving Ground ignore gates; designing uses what you know.

start.text: A new Soul caster starts with 3 remembered designs (a design picked at creation replaces Heart Bolt), the Damage, Buff and Control schools, the shape Wave (Bolt is the default), 2 feelings and one tone at Lore Master 1.

residue.text: The strongest feeling poured in leaves residue on every tile the release covered, for 2 rounds (data/feelings.json).
